prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Adoption visual and photo enhancements (style selectors, inspection screens, compact photo grids, quality callouts), split-view path layouts, wait progress checklists/carousels, background readiness hints, session reset safeguard hints, and compact welcome dashboard redesigns won.
Hurt performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts, path copy changes (flexibility, minimalist), story scroll intros, path activation incentives, interactive sound/visual wait progress, pre-certificate sign-in reordering, and most desktop finish guidance banners or spotlight/video flows hurt performance.
No clear effect seen: Audio/background notifications, standard account sync and persistence flows, waiting time indicators/overlay hints, companion archetype flows, adoption incentive badges, full bleed welcome redesigns, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low: Pre-upload style inspections, photo quality callouts, compact welcome dashboard redesigns, session safeguard hints, background readiness hints, post-adoption waiting auth reorders, and wait progress checklists performed better than predicted.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, pre-certificate sign-in reorders, instant activation highlights, split-view story intros, and all tests resulting in negative performance or no clear effect were overpredicted.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Visual Pet Style Preview Inspection Screen: Insert a dedicated style preview inspection screen before photo upload to let users select and verify visual aesthetics. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet visuals failing or looking incorrect, and visual inspection screens showed strong performance in earlier lessons.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Certificate Sign-In Stage Shift: Shift the sign-in step to occur after adoption certificate creation and before the background generation waiting screen. (why: 8 support emails cited lost or reset pets when signing in too early before companion identity is bound.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Safeguard Sign-In Hint: Add an explicit safeguard hint banner on the sign-in screen urging users to sign in with their previous authentication provider. (why: Support received 8 reports of pets missing after users signed in with a different account email.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Readiness Setup Checklist View: Configure the waiting screen with a live checklist layout showing background desktop initialization stages. (why: Home waiting stage has high mean latency (2336s); progress checklists improved retention in earlier rounds.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Guide Headline Copy: Update home_intro headline and body to provide clear, actionable instructions on how to summon and hide the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets noted user confusion about controlling, hiding, or talking to their pet once setup completed.)
5: [adoption, layout] Compact Pet Photo Framing Grid Layout: Change the upload_photos screen to a compact grid layout with explicit framing visual indicators. (why: Compact photo layouts and visual quality aids previously improved adoption conversion.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Identity Seal Incentive: Add a prominent adoption seal badge component to the adoption certificate screen to reinforce pet ownership. (why: 92% of users reach adoption; emphasizing official adoption identity encourages completion through final setup.)
7: [home, notification] Generation Complete Desktop Alert Notification: Enable desktop completion alert notifications while the pet is generating on the waiting screen. (why: Mean wait time is over 38 minutes (2336s), causing users to switch windows and lose track of pet readiness.)

scores.note: Style preview inspection screens aligned with winning visual enhancement lessons and performed better than predicted.
Pre-certificate sign-in reordering consistently hurt performance and was overpredicted in past rounds.
Session safeguard hints won previously and address 8 support reports via simple banner config.
Wait progress checklists outperformed expectations and target high mean wait times (2336s).
High drop step, but finish copy changes historically hurt performance (-5.9% measured).
Compact photo grid layouts and visual framing aids consistently improved adoption conversion.
Adoption incentive badges and activation incentives historically showed no clear effect or negative results.
Addresses 38-min wait window switching, with moderate historical lift (+2.8%) on home notifications.
